t: I've had it with this commute.
I don't mind riding the train, but I hate having to get up at five a.m. every day.
Why don't you find an apartment closer to work?
I've actually checked rental listings online.
There are some good options a few blocks from the office, but I'm not sure about this neighborhood.
It seems like a pretty dull place to live.
You know, Mark's lived here for years.
Ask him what he thinks of it.
I'll see if he has time to chat after the client meeting this afternoon.
